notes: Source drawing has two distinct front sub-pieces (labelled with piece-number suffixes '1' and '2' in the original file), each quantity given as '1' or '1 (pair)' and recorded here as qty 1 / qty 2 respectively, following the tshirt-benchmark precedent's convention. It was not possible to confirm from the drawing alone which front sub-piece is the main front panel versus a slit facing/underlay, so both are recorded generically as 'piece A' / 'piece B'. Only one back sub-piece is shown. A '3cm hem' construction note appears beside the right edge of the front-A and back panels; it is not a separate outline dimension and is not counted as its own edge.
